thread:
Olivia Martinez: drafting a customer-facing update for the latency spike — want quick eyes before we publish. putting a short initial + one periodic + resolved draft in-thread.
Incident Bot: [ALERT] 1768123456 - Inference latency anomaly detected in us-west-2. Paging oncall.
Oncall SRE: joining. I see spikes on p50/p95, KC cache misses up. investigating model shards.
Samir Kapoor: thanks — can you confirm impact scope? percentage of requests affected? which APIs (generation/embeddings)?
Jia Chen: quick numbers from logs: approx 6% of generation requests in us-west-2 had >2s extra latency over the last 7m, failures ~0.5%. embeddings unaffected so far.
Marco Ruiz: FYI customers on Dedicated in that region might see higher tail latency. we should avoid calling out tiers/public customers.
Olivia Martinez: agreed. draft initial status note below — please edit for tone and accuracy. short and simple.

```
Initial update (for status page publish):
We are investigating elevated inference latency affecting text generation requests in the US West region (us-west-2). Some customers may experience slower responses or intermittent timeouts. Our engineers are actively investigating and mitigating the issue. We will provide another update within 30 minutes.
Impact: Increased response times for a subset of generation requests in us-west-2 (~6% of recent requests). Embeddings unaffected.
Workaround / Mitigation: Automatic fallback to compatible model variants is enabled where applicable. If you need immediate relief, consider routing traffic to another region.
```

Samir Kapoor: wording looks good. change "consider routing traffic" -> "you can route"? also remove percentage numbers from public note (sensitive) — maybe say "a subset of customers".
Jia Chen: +1 on removing exact percentage. internal notes can keep numbers.
Olivia Martinez: updated draft below (removing percents) — please confirm.

```
Initial update (publish-ready):
We are investigating elevated inference latency affecting text generation requests in the US West region (us-west-2). A subset of customers may experience slower responses or intermittent timeouts. Our engineers are actively investigating and working on mitigations. We will provide another update within 30 minutes.
Impact: Increased response times for a subset of generation requests in us-west-2. Embeddings and other APIs not impacted at this time.
Workaround: Automatic fallback to compatible model variants is enabled where applicable. Customers can route traffic to another region to avoid impact.
```

Marco Ruiz: can we add a quick internal note for the status page "We will not call out individual customer names"? not in public copy, but confirm internal.
Oncall SRE: yep — internal thread we keep exact metrics and affected customer lists. public copy stays high level.
Support Bot: drafting a short customer email snippet to send to impacted accounts once we have a restore ETA. will post when ready.
Samir Kapoor: one more tweak — add "ETA: investigating" rather than a time unless we have a confident ETA. we can add a periodic update with ETA when available.
Olivia Martinez: done. publishing instructions: Samir can you run the publish command when ready? I'll review in parallel.

```
# publish (internal):
ssh ops@deploy
./bin/statuspage publish --component inference-gateway --body-file ./tmp/inference-initial.txt
```

Samir Kapoor: will publish after final check. quick ask: localizations — do we need translations for the 2nd update?
Olivia Martinez: not for the initial short update. if this extends >2h we'll run automated translation. add a note in the internal update.
Jia Chen: quick check — logs show retry throttles are contributing. mitigation running (scale up and warm KV cache). ETA unknown, will update in next periodic.

[~12 minutes later]
Oncall SRE: periodic update draft: "Engineers have identified retry throttling and cold KV cache as contributing factors. We are scaling additional capacity and warming caches; latency should improve as nodes come up. No data loss reported." feedback?
Marco Ruiz: sounds good. consider "no customer data loss" to reassure.
Olivia Martinez: ok final periodic update: short + add "no customer data loss reported".

```
Periodic update (to publish):
Engineers have identified retry throttling and cold KV cache as contributing factors. We are adding capacity and warming caches; latency should improve as capacity is provisioned. No customer data loss reported. We will provide another update within 30 minutes or when the issue is resolved.
```

Incident Bot: [ACTION] statuspage published: initial update by Samir Kapoor at 1768123570.
Samir Kapoor: published initial and periodic queued. leaving note for ops to confirm publish reach.
Support Bot: customer email snippet (internal) — edit as needed before sending to impacted accounts:


Olivia Martinez: thumbs up on the snippet. Support team — hold until we have confirmed restore or a clear ETA, but prep to send to SLA-tier accounts.

[~25 minutes later]
Jia Chen: mitigation shows drop in p95 near 50% after warmup, errors down. continuing to monitor.
Oncall SRE: pushing resolved draft.

```
Resolved notice (draft):
The issue causing elevated inference latency in US West (us-west-2) has been mitigated. Response times have returned to normal and error rates have stabilized. Root cause: retry throttles combined with cold KV cache due to recent rolling deploy; we are following up with a postmortem and improvements to warming logic.
Impact: Some customers experienced slower responses during the incident window; no customer data loss.
If you continue to experience problems, please contact support.
```

Samir Kapoor: published resolved notice at 1768124123. Nice work team.
Olivia Martinez: closing loop — I'll start the postmortem doc and ping oncall for timeline. thanks all. :rocket:
Support Bot: queued customer emails for impacted SLA accounts — hold for legal signoff if needed.
Incident Bot: incident 1768123456 closed at 1768124123.
Olivia Martinez: will follow up in #postmortems with the draft."
